subject: Re: facet_grid not compatible with error bars?

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: facet_grid not compatible with error bars?
parts:
Hi,

The data has to be re-sorted to for the facets, so your points and
errorbars are no longer matching. Omit the reference to the data frame
in your geom_errorbarh call and all should be well:

ggplot(cdata, aes(y=Depth, x = av, shape = TR1, color = TR1)) +
geom_point(size = 1) +
geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = av+se, xmin = av-se)) +
facet_grid(Station~Code)


Best,
Ista

On Wed, Jun 12, 2013 at 2:58 AM, uli <ulrikeb...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi there!
>
>
>
> I've been playing around with ggplot2 (but I'm not that experienced), trying
> to construct a graph that shows depth profiles of 2 stations in 3 months
> (see "profiles_noerrorbars.png"). However, when I try to put errorbars on
> top of the means, it goes wrong ("profiles_errorbars.png"). I've browsed
> through all topics concerning facet_grid and reordering facets, but I cannot
> find the solution. When no facetting or single facetting is applied, all
> goes well.
>
>
>
> this is the code:
>
>
>
> data <- read.table("profiledata.txt", header = T)
>
>
> data$Depth <- -data$Depth
>
>
> library(ggplot2)
>
> library(plyr)
>
>
> cdata <- ddply(data, .(ExpID, Month, Station, TR1, Replicate, Depth ),
> summarise,
>
> N = length(Signal1),
>
> av = mean(Signal1),
>
> sd = sd(Signal1),
>
> se = sd(Signal1)/sqrt(N-1))
>
>
> Code <- paste(cdata$ExpID, cdata$Month, sep = " ")
>
>
> cdata <- cbind(cdata, Code)
>
>
> rhg_cols1<- c("#000000","#999999" )
>
>
> ggplot(cdata, aes(y=Depth, x = av, group = Station, shape = TR1, color =
> TR1)) +
>
> geom_point(size = 4) +
>
> geom_errorbarh(aes(xmax = cdata$av +cdata$se, xmin = cdata$av -
> cdata$se), width=0.2) +
>
> facet_grid(Station~Code) +
>
>
>
> theme_bw() +
>
> theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank(), panel.grid.major=element_blank())
> +
>
> scale_color_manual(values = rhg_cols1) +
>
> ylab("") +
>
> xlab("" ) +
>
> theme(axis.text.x=element_text(size=10)) +
>
> theme(axis.text.y=element_text(size=10)) +
>
> theme(axis.title.x=element_text(size=10)) +
>
> theme(axis.title.y=element_text(angle = 90, size=10)) +
>
> theme(strip.text.x = element_text(size=10) )
>
>
>
> and the data are in attachment (".Rdata")
>
>
>
> Thanks in advance for any help!
>
